properties.NAME: German Coast County
properties.CHANGE: German Coast County created by Orleans Territory to "comprehend the [ecclesiastical] parishes of St. Charles and St. John the Baptist, commonly called the first and second German Coasts."
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1804, 1st Leg., 1st sess., ch. 25/p. 144-152; Calhoun, 72-80; Goins and Caldwell, 41)
